items.title: 2.4 Equations of motion (motion ki equations) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.4 with Figs. 2.5 to 2.7 and Examples 2.2 to 2.4 (PDF 28-33, printed 25-30).

blocks.text: Equations of motion kisi cheez ki motion ko teen kinematic variables se describe karti hain: velocity (v), position (s) aur time (t). In teenon ke pairs (jore) teen tarah bante hain: velocity-time, position-time aur velocity-position. Isi order (tarteeb) se inhen pehli, doosri aur teesri equation of motion kehte hain.
Yeh equations sirf un cheezon par lagti hain jo straight line (seedhi line) mein constant (na badalne wali) acceleration se chal rahi hon.
